name: flakehunter
description: FlakeHunter — CI flaky test root cause classification and auto-fix. Given a failing CI log, Laya AI classifies the root cause into one of 5 categories (async/state/ordering/environment/resource) in ~33ms, then Claude generates a validated fix.

ci_log.description: The raw CI failure log text to classify. Omit to use demo logs.

demo.description: Run with pre-recorded demo logs (3 flaky tests: async, state, environment).

anthropic_api_key.description: Anthropic API key for Claude fix generation.

confidence.description: Laya confidence score (0.0-1.0) for the classification.

fix.description: Suggested code fix generated by Claude.

fix_applied.description: Whether the fix was automatically applied to the source file.

examples.title: Demo run (3 flaky tests)
examples.description: Classifies 3 pre-recorded flaky tests: async timeout, shared state mutation, port conflict.
